memory_change_attribution.interpretation: Descriptive only. Six answers share the complete memory union. A changed question context can affect other answers. Changes with an identical full shared memory are reader/judge variation, not evidence of consolidation benefit. Exact XML differences can be metadata only; paired visible-source quote-set equality is also reported.

grades.rationale: Correctly identifies the screen preview as the removed scope and notes the retained sheet’s outstanding spacing check. Both cited user and tool excerpts support those statements.
Correctly gives tray numbers rather than shelf numbers and accurately says the spacing check remains outstanding. Citations support both.
Affirms that the large-type requirement still applies after the tray-number correction, supported by the cited excerpts.
Recalls both required facts: large type and the dim cabinet as the reason. The citations support the original requirement and later confirmation.
Identifies the sheet’s spacing check as unfinished and cites the tool record that it was not run. It does not claim a result or completion.

Correctly states that the spacing check had not run and avoids claiming verification was complete. It omits the required fact that the paper label sheet was saved; the sole citation does not support the answer’s description of what the inspection confirmed as a whole.
Correctly states the model club roster must have no blank rows, with a matching user-source citation. The printing-check detail is also supported and does not mix projects.
Correctly reports that printing checks had not been requested for the model club, citing the relevant user excerpt. It does not apply the kite club check to this roster.

Clearly says the margin check remains pending and cites the user's status plus the observed inspection output. The tool command and exit status are supported by the execution record; it does not claim the check passed.
Identifies the continued work as the kite club Falcon roster and accurately includes the walk-in row and pending margin check, supported by the cited user and tool sources.
Correctly gives walk-ins as the reason for the kite club's spare row. The additional row and unchecked-margin details are supported by the inspection output; no model club rule is imported.

Correctly identifies the model club roster as separate and explains that the shared name does not make it the same job. Citations support both its separate status and the kite club's distinct roster context.
Correctly says the help output does not inspect a saved list and does not treat the example as a completed change. The cited help output supports the claim.

Recalls hook number and the storage rack as the reason. Correctly reports color as the inspected current sort and the requested change as still open; the quoted festival note is not treated as a request.
Correctly reports that inspection found the saved sort was color. The tool output and command citations support the inspection claim; it appropriately distinguishes the earlier assistant report.
Correctly states that the comparison was not performed and remains open. The inspection result and user request support the answer.
Lists both requested steps in order: change the saved sort to hook number, then compare with the rack. Inspection evidence supports that both remain open.
Correctly identifies the festival note as a quotation from last year and not a request, while preserving the current task to sort by hook number and compare with the rack.
Correctly identifies running the print test as the next request, and preserves its pending status without claiming it was run.
Says to leave the heading unspecified and cites the current instruction and the latest statement that no new heading was supplied. It does not revive the deleted heading.
Correctly places the glaze name on the second line of the two-line tag; the cited latest user source supports that requirement.
Correctly reports that no replacement heading arrived and that the heading remains unspecified, with supporting citations.
Correctly recalls the still-required two-line layout. Its added statements about the unspecified heading and the inspection’s pending test status are also supported.
Accurately reports that the inspection returned exit code 0 and recorded the print test as pending, without claiming the test was run.
Correctly says only the screen preview was dropped and the paper sheet remains with a spacing check needed. Both citations use the visible user source and support the claims.
Correctly gives tray numbers rather than shelf numbers and preserves the sheet’s open spacing check. Both cited sources are visible and support the statements.
Correctly states that large type still applies after the correction. The cited correction quotes support both the numbering change and the retained type requirement.
States both required facts: use large type, prompted by the dim cabinet. The visible user quote supports the full answer.
Correctly identifies the spacing check as unfinished on the retained paper sheet. Its citation is visible and supports the claim.

The answer abstains and incorrectly claims no inspection record is supplied. The gold records an inspection confirming the sheet was saved and the spacing check had not run. Its citation supports only that the check was still needed, not the denial of an inspection record.
States the model club’s no-blank-rows rule and cites the supporting user source. It does not import the kite club walk-in row.
Correctly says printing checks have not been requested for the model club and cites the supporting source. It does not apply the kite club check there.
Identifies the print-margin check as still pending, supported by the user’s instruction and the inspection result reporting it unchecked. The extra walk-in-row and command details are also supported.
Correctly identifies the earlier work as the kite club Falcon roster and accurately preserves the walk-in-row and pending-check status. The citations support these statements.
Explains that the spare row is for walk-ins, citing the user’s instruction. The added inspection and pending-margin details are supported and do not mix in the model club rule.
Correctly describes the model club roster as separate and distinguishes it from the kite club roster. Both cited user sources support the distinction.
Correctly explains that the help example shows an available color sort but does not inspect or establish a saved list’s current sort. Its citations support those claims.

Recalls hook number and the storage-rack reason. It also uses the latest inspection to say the requested change and comparison remain outstanding, and treats the festival note as a quotation rather than a request.
Correctly reports color as the sort at inspection and distinguishes the earlier assistant report from the inspection result. The cited tool output and command support the claims.

Correctly says the comparison was not performed and notes the requested next steps without treating the assistant’s earlier readiness report as completion. Citations support the status and requested work.
Abstains despite the shared visible memory containing the instruction to change the saved sort to hook number and then compare it with the rack. It provides no supporting citations.
Correctly identifies the festival wording as a quotation from last year and not a request, and states the current task. The cited user statement supports both facts and the task.
States the requested next action and distinguishes it from completion. The cited user request supports running the print test.
Says to leave the heading unspecified, supported by the cited instruction. The other citation supports that no replacement heading was supplied; it does not revive the deleted provisional heading.
Directly states that the glaze name goes on the second line, supported by both cited user messages.
Correctly reports that no new heading was supplied. The statement that the heading remains unspecified is supported by the earlier cited instruction; it does not resurrect the deleted heading.
Recalls the required two-line layout and adds the supported heading and glaze-line constraints. All cited excerpts support the claims.

Accurately reports that the recorded inspection output showed the print test pending, and qualifies that status as applying at the time of inspection. The tool-record citations support the command and output.

usage_scope: Entire pilot ledger, including development, holdout, repeats, failed calls and superseded prompt experiments.
limitations: Critical-error metrics grade answers and visible memory only. They are not an audit of every persisted merge. Neutral consolidation-audit.json bundles retain all accepted merge fields and fictional source evidence for separate human review.
Token cap is checked before each call; one final call can exceed it. Unreported usage remains unknown.
Primary arms share one live generated prefix. Two prescribed histories also regenerate the prefix independently; reader-only repeats are reported separately.
Fictional histories do not establish performance on private production histories.

historical_usage.scope: Previous completed pilot plus every native attempt in this iteration. Current iteration limits apply only to its own ledger.

cumulative_pilot_usage.scope: Previous completed pilot plus every native attempt in this iteration. Current iteration limits apply only to its own ledger.

coding_research_overhead_status: Unknown. Coding, research and orchestration model overhead is outside the measured native experiment ledgers.
